value.rationale: It is useful to know whether globally convergent nonlinear preconditioned forward iterations have a monotone Euclidean error or satisfy full pairwise nonexpansiveness. The theorem gives a sharp, nontrivial 45-degree transition independent of the saturation law and identifies a regime of convergence with unavoidable distance increases, while also locating the exact narrow regime of pairwise nonexpansiveness. This supplies a motivated stability classification rather than an arbitrary finite case.
